title: Learning Scientific Exploration from Human Research Decision Trajectories
focus_en: Extracts researchers' decisions from Git histories. Compares using examples and distilled skills at inference time with SFT and RL for choosing the next research action.
focus_zh: 从 Git 历史提取研究者的决策，比较推理时使用示例与提炼技能，以及用 SFT、RL 学习选择下一步研究行动。
boundary_en: Git commits capture only part of research experience. Evaluation mainly checks similarity to recorded decisions, not whether the learned policy produces important new discoveries.
boundary_zh: Git 提交只能记录部分研究经验。评价主要检查决策与历史记录的相似度，未验证所学策略能否产生重要的新发现。

title: Structure Liberates: How Constrained Sensemaking Produces More Novel Research Output
focus_en: Builds structured ideation traces grounded in cited papers and uses them for supervised training of research-planning models. Compares reconstructing known contributions with generating new research ideas.
focus_zh: 依据引用文献构建结构化构思轨迹，用于监督训练研究规划模型，并比较重建已知贡献与生成新研究想法。
boundary_en: The traces are synthetic, not recordings of human reasoning. Novelty ratings and a small computer-science execution study do not establish general scientific value. Released code covers SFT and evaluation, but not the exploratory RL experiments.
boundary_zh: 轨迹由模型合成，并非人类思考的真实记录。新颖性评分和小规模计算机科学执行实验不能确立通用科学价值。公开代码覆盖 SFT 与评价，不含探索性 RL 实验。

title: Learning to Ideate for Machine Learning Engineering Agents
focus_en: Separates idea generation from implementation. Trains the ideator with RL rewards from execution results and tests its guidance on held-out ML engineering tasks.
focus_zh: 将构思与实现分开，用执行结果提供的 RL 奖励训练构思模型，再在留出的 ML 工程任务上测试其指导作用。
boundary_en: Tasks have supplied MLE-Bench goals. Results test transfer of engineering guidance, not valuable question selection. The reported evaluation omits high-complexity tasks.
boundary_zh: 任务目标由 MLE-Bench 给定。结果检验工程指导能力的迁移，不检验有价值问题的选择。报告中的评价未覆盖高复杂度任务。

title: InternAgent-1.5: A Unified Agentic Framework for Long-Horizon Autonomous Scientific Discovery
focus_en: Reuses research experience through strategy memory, experiment records within a run, and knowledge retained across sessions. Links generation, verification, and evolution in long research workflows.
focus_zh: 通过策略记忆、单次运行内的实验记录和跨会话知识复用研究经验，在长周期研究中连接生成、验证与演化。
boundary_en: Memory supports both adaptation within a run and reuse across runs. The results do not isolate cross-domain strategy transfer or show that weight updates teach the base model research taste.
boundary_zh: 记忆同时支持单次运行内适应和跨运行复用。现有结果未单独验证跨领域策略迁移，也未证明基础模型通过参数更新学会科研品味。

title: AutoResearchClaw: Self-Reinforcing Autonomous Research with Human-AI Collaboration
focus_en: Stores lessons from failed research runs, reduces their weight over time, and retrieves them to avoid later mistakes. Human involvement is configurable.
focus_zh: 保存失败研究中的经验，随时间降低其权重，并在后续研究中检索以避免重复错误；人类参与程度可配置。
boundary_en: It reuses external lessons without training the model. Ablations mainly show fewer known failures, not evidence of a higher scientific-quality ceiling or learned judgment of research importance.
boundary_zh: 它复用外部经验，不训练模型。消融实验主要显示已知错误减少，未证明科学质量上限提高或学会判断研究的重要性。

title: Bilevel Autoresearch: Meta-Autoresearching Itself
focus_en: An outer loop reads search records and rewrites the Python search strategy. This changes how an inner autoresearch loop proposes and evaluates training settings.
focus_zh: 外层循环读取搜索记录并改写 Python 搜索策略，改变内层 autoresearch 循环提出和评价训练配置的方式。
boundary_en: Evidence comes from a small repeated study of one GPT pretraining task. It changes search code, not model weights; cross-task transfer and unbounded recursive improvement are not demonstrated.
boundary_zh: 证据来自单个 GPT 预训练任务的少量重复实验。改动的是搜索代码而非模型参数；未证明跨任务迁移或无限递归改进。

title: Learning to Discover at Test Time
focus_en: Updates model weights with RL while searching for a solution to one problem. Uses continuous rewards in mathematics, kernels, algorithms, and biological data analysis.
focus_zh: 在搜索单个问题的解时，用 RL 更新模型参数，并在数学、算子、算法和生物数据分析中使用连续奖励。
boundary_en: The objective and evaluator are supplied. Task-specific test-time training does not establish retained gains on new tasks or the ability to choose important research questions.
boundary_zh: 目标和评价器由环境给定。单任务测试时训练不能证明能力提升会保留到新任务，也未验证重要研究问题的选择能力。

title: OR-Agent: Bridging Evolutionary Search and Structured Research for Automated Heuristic Design
focus_en: Uses tree search and backtracking to improve heuristics. Reflections, result summaries, and accumulated lessons guide later branches within the same optimization run.
focus_zh: 通过树搜索与回溯改进启发式算法，用反思、结果总结和累积经验指导同一优化过程中的后续分支。
boundary_en: Tests use specified combinatorial and simulation optimization tasks. Verbal gradients and momentum describe reflection, not weight updates; cross-task research-strategy transfer is not established.
boundary_zh: 测试针对给定的组合优化与仿真优化任务。“语言梯度”和“动量”描述反思机制，不是参数更新；未验证科研策略的跨任务迁移。

title: Evolution Fine-Tuning: Learning to Discover Across 371 Optimization Tasks
focus_en: Uses evolutionary search traces from several optimization domains for supervised training of Finch models. Tests transfer to held-out tasks and combination with test-time RL.
focus_zh: 用多个优化领域的进化搜索轨迹监督训练 Finch 模型，测试对留出任务的迁移，以及与测试时 RL 的结合。
boundary_en: Training transfers across tasks with supplied objectives and evaluators; this does not show that the model learns question importance. Data collection and main evaluations use one search framework, so broad transfer across research workflows is not established.
boundary_zh: 训练在给定目标和评价器的任务间迁移，不代表学会判断问题重要性。数据收集和主要评价使用同一搜索框架，尚未证明跨科研工作流的广泛迁移。
